hfgt_toolbox.logging module

Module to initialise loguru console and file loggers. Also provides two log_entry_exit functions to assist with the traceability of the code. @author Michael Stewart

hfgt_toolbox.logging.log_entry_exit_info(func)

Decorator that logs entry and exit of a function with indentation based on call depth. Intended to be a cleaner replacement for ‘print(“I am entering/exiting…”)’ at the start and end of every function.

This function was written by Microsoft Copilot.

hfgt_toolbox.logging.log_entry_exit_trace(func)

Similar to log_entry_exit above. MS: I split these functions because originally, some functions had “if verboseMode: “ around the “I am entering…” and “I am exiting…” print statements. Those functions use this function, whereas the ones that did not use log_entry_exit_info above.

hfgt_toolbox.logging.update_logging_level(level)

Update the logging level of the stderr_handler to the desired level.

Parameters:

level (str) – The logging level to update to, e.g. “DEBUG”.
